feature-approval-required: Larim ol samting ol nupela vesin bilong WeKan i skruim i no wok inap wanpela admin i mekim ol i wok
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu bilong bod → Sotpela tok i soim wanem samting olgeta wan wan i mekim long bod long las de o wik, na wanem i lait pinis.
feature-pilot-users: Ol manmeri bilong traim sistem husat i lukim ol samting i no wok tu
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Ol nem bilong yusa, brukim wantaim koma

feature-preview-admins: Ol admin i lukim ol samting i no wok bilong traim ol pastaim
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu bilong bod → Ol Lo i tingim ol lo long ol samting ol man i save mekim long han planti taim.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Painim long olgeta hap i save ol tok olsem "ol kat bilong mi i lait".
feature-since-last-visit: Long taim yu kam las taim
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu bilong bod → Long taim yu kam las taim i soim wanem ol arapela i senisim long bod.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalenda na kalenda bilong planti bot.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bot olsem ples wok bilong toktok: ol ples wok, ol bot, ol rot, ol lis na ol kat olsem diwai bilong ol sanel, kat i stap long namel na ol tok bilong en olsem ol toksave bilong toktok.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Wankain ol kat long planti set bilong kolum i gat nem - long pinis, namba wan wok, mak o wanem samting - ol i muv namel long ol kolum long pulim.
feature-views-email-desc: Bot olsem meilboks: lis bilong imel em Imel i kam insait, ol lis em ol fola, ol mak em ol mak, na ol memba i raitim na bekim imel long adres bilong bot.
feature-views-flow-charts: Ol sat bilong ron bilong wok
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Wok i stap yet, wok i pinis, ron bilong wok i bung, taim bilong mekim wok na taim long askim inap long pinis, hamas wok i pinis, hamas taim wok i wet, ol samting i pasim wok, Monte Carlo na ol arapela mak bilong ron bilong wok.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Tripela lukluk bilong ol sat bilong Gantt.
feature-views-map-desc: Ol kat olsem mak long piksa yu putim i go antap.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ol namba, bungim long grup bihainim man o meri i kisim wok, plen bilong wok, bot bilong lukautim wok na bikpela bot.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Ol wok bilong prodak i stap yet, ol sotpela taim bilong wok, ripot bilong dispela taim na spid bilong wok.
feature-views-table-desc: Bot olsem wanpela tebol bilong ol kat yu ken putim long oda.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bot olsem ples bilong lukautim ol hevi bilong GitHub o Gitea: ol kat olsem ol hevi, ol mak na ol bikpela mak, ol tok olsem toktok, ol samting i pas olsem ol fail, na ol samting i kamap bipo long bot wantaim senisim i go bek.
